def f(l, r):
    n = len(r)
    max_xor = 0

        for j in range(i, n):
            xor_value = 0
            for k in range(i, j + 1):
                xor_value ^= int(l[k])
            max_xor = max(max_xor, xor_value)
    return max_xor
